per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Packet material remains a source inventory/extraction layer; XML tables, PDF text, OA figures/NXML, supplementary PDF text, and database JSONL were reopened for this re-review.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Structural files exist and strict worker-6 provenance fields are present; validator success is not used as publication-grade evidence by itself.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_2_activity_toxicity: Primary XML Table 1 and Table 2 now produce source-located MIC rows with units, target species/strain/isolate context, and comparator identity. Figure/text toxicity values relevant to database rows are recorded with scope guards.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_4_database: DBAASP assay/literature rows are matched to primary tables/text/figures where support exists; a CAMP mixed activity row remains source_conflict with explicit context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_final_adjudication: The paper is accepted_with_cautions because all hard blockers are resolved but conflict and figure-quantitation cautions remain.
per_layer_decision_rationale.semantic_gate: Expected to pass after rework because review_status/publication_grade are publication-grade and hard activity/database/mechanism checks have source locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: Accepted with cautions, not accepted_clean; no open rework ticket remains after bounded source review.

caution_findings.evidence_context: One CAMP entry-level activity row mixes source-supported targets with unsupported or conflicting values; it remains source_conflict instead of being normalized into source_verified.
Figure-only exact curves for mechanism and in vivo efficacy were not digitized; final claims retain text/caption-supported direction and assay class.
A database row uses Klebsiella aerogenes where the primary table label uses Enterobacter aerogenes; source and database labels are both retained in the audit context.
